01. About

I work across the stack.

SQL for extraction, Python for analysis, Power BI for stakeholders. What matters isn't the tool — it's whether the numbers survive scrutiny.

I'm an aspiring analytics engineer focused on funnels, conversion, and revenue impact. I don't ship a dashboard until the underlying logic is clean and every claim is tested.

Right now: building a portfolio of analysis projects across different domains (e-commerce, HR, SQL), each one practicing a different technical skill — messy data, statistical testing, multi-table queries. Each project is real: real problem, real solution, real impact.

Why this matters: most analysts stop at "here's the chart." I stop at "here's why the chart matters, and here's the test that proves it."

03. Featured Work

Projects that move the needle.

Real problems. Real data. Every claim tested before it ships.

E-Commerce Funnel & Conversion Analysis

Python • Pandas • Streamlit
Rebuilt raw session logs into a full purchase funnel, segmented by channel/region/device/category, then ran a chi-square significance test before trusting any segment differences. Result: channel gap was statistical noise, the real problem was checkout, losing 69% of all users. Shipped as an interactive Streamlit dashboard with live filters and Excel export.

Recruitment Pipeline Dashboard

Power BI • DAX • Star Schema
HR had no single view of where candidates drop off or how long hiring takes. I built an interactive Power BI dashboard on a star-schema model that tracks 900 applications through a 6-stage funnel, from Applied to Hired. DAX-driven KPIs and slicers by department, company and date show exactly where the pipeline leaks.
